files.caption: Three photographs of 2807 East Central Avenue, Middletown, Ohio. Photographs are undated. The real estate listing for 2807 East Central Avenue reads: Near Roosevelt School. Attractive two-and-one-half story residence. Large living room, den, family size dining room, breakfast nook, lavatory and modern kitchen down. Three bedrooms and tile bath on second floor. Stairway to finished third floor. Oak finish, gas heat, 2-car garage.
